Kaplan–Meier plot: supplied survival curve versus individual-level data

Source: R/ggKaplanMeier.R
ggKM.Xvs1.Rd

Arm 0 is a survival curve supplied as vectors (for example, pooled across multiply imputed datasets); arm 1 is individual-level survival data.

Usage

ggKM.Xvs1(
  KMtime0,
  KMlower0,
  KMsurv0,
  KMupper0,
  KMatrisk0,
  survtime1,
  survstatus1,
  breaks.s = seq(0, 1, 0.25),
  breaks.t = NULL,
  CI = TRUE,
  CI.alpha = 0.2,
  colors = c("#0087BD", "#C40233"),
  digits.fixed = 1,
  grid.color = grDevices::rgb(0.95, 0.95, 0.95),
  grid.s = seq(0, 1, 0.25),
  grid.t = NULL,
  grid.width = 0.5,
  legend.direction = "vertical",
  legend.just = c("right", "top"),
  legend.label.pos = "left",
  legend.labels = NULL,
  legend.ncol = NULL,
  legend.nrow = NULL,
  legend.pos = c(1, 1),
  legend.text.align = 1,
  margin.KM.b = 0,
  margin.KM.l = 0,
  margin.KM.r = 0,
  margin.KM.t = 4,
  margin.risk = 16,
  line.width = 0.5,
  line.height = 0.025,
  max.t = NULL,
  risk.table = 2,
  risk.table.prop = 0.1,
  t.labels = NULL,
  textsize.axis = 12,
  textsize.legend = 12,
  textsize.risk = 12,
  title.s = "Survival",
  title.t = "Time"
)

Arguments

KMtime0

Numeric vector of time points for arm 0, sorted in ascending order.

KMlower0

Numeric vector of lower confidence limits for arm 0.

KMsurv0

Numeric vector of survival estimates for arm 0.

KMupper0

Numeric vector of upper confidence limits for arm 0.

KMatrisk0

Numeric vector of numbers at risk for arm 0 (may be non-integer).

survtime1

Numeric vector of follow-up times for arm 1.

survstatus1

Integer vector event indicator for arm 1 (1 = event, 0 = censored).

CI

Logical; draw confidence intervals. Default = TRUE. Arm 0 uses the supplied limits and arm 1 uses Greenwood's variance with the complementary log–log transformation.

digits.fixed

Decimal places for arm 0's number at risk. Default = 1.

Details

Other arguments are as in ggKM. No censor marks are drawn for arm 0.
